description: This file implements functions for maintaining and establishing ADB (Android Debug Bridge) connections, including sending commands, handling responses, and managing connection states within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: MakeMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message string with a 4-character hex length prefix followed by the user message.

methods.name: MakeShellUptimeMessage
methods.description: Creates a message to request system uptime via adb shell.

methods.name: MakeShellTradeInModeGetStatusMessage
methods.description: Creates a message to get trade-in mode status via adb shell.

methods.name: MakeTransportMessage
methods.description: Creates a transport command message for a specific device address.

methods.name: MakeConnectMessage
methods.description: Creates a connect command message for a specific device address.

methods.name: MakeDisconnectMessage
methods.description: Creates a disconnect command message for a specific device address.

methods.name: MakeGetStateMessage
methods.description: Creates a get-state command message for a specific device address.

methods.name: AdbSendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the adb daemon over a socket and checks for an OKAY response.

methods.name: AdbConnect
methods.description: Initiates an adb connection to a specified device address.

methods.name: AdbDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects an adb connection from a specified device address.

methods.name: IsHexInteger
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid hexadecimal integer.

methods.name: IsInteger
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid decimal integer.

methods.name: RecvAdbResponse
methods.description: Receives an adb response message, parsing the length prefix and reading the message body.

methods.name: RecvUptimeResult
methods.description: Reads and parses the uptime result from an adb shell command.

methods.name: RecvGetStatusResult
methods.description: Reads and parses the get-status result from an adb shell command.

methods.name: WaitForAdbAuthorization
methods.description: Checks if the adb connection is waiting for user authorization.

methods.name: EstablishConnection
methods.description: Attempts to establish an adb connection and handle authorization.

methods.name: WaitForAdbDisconnection
methods.description: Monitors and waits for the adb device to disconnect.
